purpose: Freeze a compact, deliberately non-cartesian suite of physical, scientific and downstream demand shapes. Select smallest decision-changing experiments; unexecuted critical cases prevent grade promotion, not lawful independent implementation.

global.source_truth: actual source qualified or labeled SOURCEFREE; event count, respondent risk, denominator, weights, wave and respondent/household grain separately recorded

cases.name: sparse event density versus wide instrument
axes: events_per_respondent=historical sparse measured ≈3.245 baseline if comparable
cases.test: first source one-pass construction and cold proof/1,10,100 distinct workload; record actual nonmissing events; sparse alone never extrapolates dense cost
cases.scope: replicate historical sourcefree baseline only with exact original input/runner or newly qualified fixture

cases.name: dense eligible/high-event questionnaire
axes: hundreds actual answer/occurrence events per respondent or justifiably scaled representative density
cases.test: measure full-size within permitted RSS or calibrated stratified scale plus explicit extrapolation uncertainty; no extrapolation treated as measurement
cases.scope: dense sourcefree synthetic unless native authorized

cases.name: routed/multiform/multirespondent topology
axes: asked vs eligible vs observed vs not-released
cases.test: qualifying positive, denied and restored source→C11→I03 meaning with exact denominator and release provenance
cases.scope: real source if qualified or sourcefree explicit negatives

cases.name: query overlap extremes
cases.test: paired A/B same encoded operations; independently report cold seal/open, first distinct operation, later operation and reuse invalidation

cases.name: genuine three-way joint, tails and recursive minority
cases.test: first F1-F4 true joint branch changes; invalid risk/denominator refuses; restoration matches
cases.scope: actual selected first reader if sourcefree authorized; else exact hold

cases.name: repeated world/Field Forge demand
axes: multiple conditioned descriptive queries across different positions
multiple fictional actors/world forks reuse evidence
invalidated rights, source version and as-of clock
cases.test: model demand distribution from actual planned consumer and measure existing matching query primitive; no fake production person engine

cases.name: cold fault, tamper, restore and lifecycle
axes: physical body integrity distinct from manifest hash
cases.test: positive, tamper/refuse and restore on actual existing native saved first reader; verify source root and index invalidation
cases.scope: sourcefree or native as legally available

sampling_rule: At H0 freeze every case as mandatory architectural stress consideration; at A/B P0 name smallest representative probe that can change selection. Neither force every Cartesian pairing nor allow a sparse-only benchmark to prove dense viability. Missing decisive case -> CONDITIONAL_CANDIDATE/DECISION_BLOCKED_EXACT with both outcomes.
comparison: Hard veto first; relative cost compare matched same fixtures & process tree, data event counts and method; user precedence = real next product and least irreversible change. Conservative tie-break after demonstrated sufficiency and absent material rival gain = least disruptive accepted-code adaptation. This does NOT permit an unmeasured alternative to be called inferior.
